explanation: Atkinson took Mr. Bean to the London 2012 Olympic opening ceremony, playing one note again and again in Chariots of Fire with the London Symphony Orchestra.

claims.text: Rowan Atkinson created Mr. Bean, with Richard Curtis, and played him.
Hugh Laurie, John Cleese and Stephen Fry did not play Mr. Bean.
Rowan Atkinson appeared as Mr. Bean at the opening ceremony of the London 2012 Olympic Games.
In that sketch Atkinson played one repeated note in Chariots of Fire with the London Symphony Orchestra.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Rival test: Laurie, Cleese and Fry are British comic actors of similar fame, and Laurie and Fry worked with Atkinson on Blackadder. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: a British character known worldwide precisely because he barely speaks. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 26 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json, no match. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: none beyond the high-risk claims flagged for external evidence.
